text:
sana: quick heads-up: onboarding Stargaze LoRA v1.2 on llama-13b-int4. quick evalpack (invoice-v2) shows currency cents dropped and some symbol loss.
matt: ack. command used?
sana: `rwd-eval run --pack invoice-v2 --model llama-13b-int4 --adapter stargaze-lora-v1.2 --out /tmp/s-eval.json`
eva: initial diff: cents removed in ~25% of samples; looks tied to quant + kv-cache.
matt: tokenizer check: tokenization of '€ 12.50' matches.
oliver: infra-bot: smoke-test on stg-node-3: OOM at step 42; others finished. infra-bot: smoke failed on node-3 (alloc 7.4GB).
sana: hypothesis: adapter writes to early KV layers; int4 quantization amplifies rounding so currency token logits collapse. plan: 1) serve with `--kv-cache=false` 2) run deterministic evalpack 3) dump logits for currency token ids.
matt: ran with kv_cache=false on small host: cents preserved. kv_cache=true reproduces drop ~28%.
eva: try adapter-scale 0.7 and per-channel rescale patch.
matt: adapter-scale 0.7 lowers failures to ~4%.
oliver: filing ENG-RT-4123: check embedding layout + kernel selector differences across nodes.
sana: short-term: recommend kv_cache disabled for customer canary; EVA to open adapter patch PR. matt: export eval CSV and run dedicated canary. infra-bot: artifact uploaded: /artifacts/stargaze/4867891234/eval-200.csv
matt: canary done 12 p50 +3% with kv_cache off; cents preserved.
eva: PR: stargaze/adapter-fix branch with unit test and reproducer.
sana: update customer: disable kv_cache temporarily; we'll validate runtime fix and adapter patch before rollout. :thumbsup:
